📊 Weekly Uptime Report

How it works: Add name patterns (SQL LIKE syntax — use % as wildcard) to auto-classify agent-discovered software. Click ⚡ Apply to All to enrich all existing entries. New agent heartbeats are enriched automatically. Example: wso2% matches wso2-identity-server, wso2am, etc.

How it works: Each tracker checks the latest published version of a software product (via GitHub, Jenkins update center, or a URL). It compares against what your agents report as installed. Checks run automatically every 6 hours. You will receive a daily email alert for any server with outdated packages.
